raw:
VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have diagnosed the problem (missing TTL and invalidation), implemented a fix, and run 23 passing tests, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, diffs, test output, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot establish that stale quotes are actually no longer being served or that all tests genuinely pass.
